_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 8.80x; +50% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.83; conservative 2yr -6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.4%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2018-07-13) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 8.80x (72.5% downside to Bear $58 / +8.2% upside to Bull $228) | Adj composite 2.36 vs market 3.19: gap -0.83 [OVERVALUED] | +50% above the EPP floor $141 (18x FY18E $7.83) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.9% total (-2.9%/yr) | At 26.9x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $279 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +8.6% in Q1 2018, forward revenues +7.8% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2018 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
